ios.desc:
Build a checklist once. Check it off. Reset it. Run it again.
DoRepeat is the recurring checklist app for morning routines, meeting prep, weekly chores, and anything you repeat. 

Unlike to-do apps, DoRepeat is built for lists you use over and over – not tasks you check off once.

THE CHECKLIST APP FOR ANYTHING YOU DO ON REPEAT

Life is full of things we do over and over. Morning routines. Packing for trips. Monthly bills. Meeting prep. Quality checks.

That’s where DoRepeat comes in. It’s a checklist app built for the tasks you repeat, because some things are too important to leave to memory (or sticky notes that fall off your monitor).

RECURRING LISTS, ZERO HASSLE

Create checklists once, use them forever. Morning routine? Saved. Packing list for your weekend getaway? Saved. Monthly team meeting prep? You guessed it – saved. No more recreating the same list every time. Just check off your tasks, hit reset, and you’re ready to go again.

CHECK OFF TASKS WITHOUT OPENING THE APP

With home screen and lock screen widgets, you can tick off tasks without even opening the app. Because you’re busy and don’t have time for those extra taps.

REMINDERS FOR LISTS AND TASKS

When you need an extra nudge, you can set a reminder (or two, or ten) for any checklist or task.

ICLOUD SYNC

Start a checklist on your iPhone and complete it on your iPad. Your lists are everywhere you go.

WHAT PEOPLE USE DOREPEAT FOR

People rely on DoRepeat for anything from staying consistent with a personal habit to nailing quality control at the job. Here are some more examples:

• Morning Routine
• Meeting Wrap-Up
• Skincare Routine
• Workday wrap-up
• Evening Wind Down
• Monthly Budgeting
• Medication Management
• Weekly Household Tasks
• Workouts
• Preparing for Calls
• Software Release Checklist
• … and many more

Manage an unlimited number of lists, organized in beautiful color cards. Edit your lists anytime as your routines may grow or change. You can have multiple checklists in progress at the same time and use your lists for daily, weekly, monthly repeating tasks.

quotes.text:
When I built my little side project (B2C iPhone app, not a SaaS [1]), I documented the development process on LinkedIn with short "developer diary" videos. That has led to a good amount of engagement at launch, which briefly lifted the app into the top-paid section on the App Store for a short time. That was enough to reach the first 100 users within a few days.

Since it's a side project, I haven't worked on the app in a while, but recently picked up development again. So if you have any ideas or suggestions, they are very welcome.

[1] https://apps.apple.com/app/dorepeat-checklists-todos/id1561534712
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: How are you acquiring your first hundred users?
